# Checkpoint requirements

The repository does not contain trained model weights. Checkpoints are excluded because the files are large and the reported runs were stored in Google Drive during Colab training.

Paths such as `/path/to/autoencoder_final.pt` in the commands are placeholders. Replace them with an existing local or mounted-drive path.

## Files generated by each training run

### CIFAR-10 geometry run

Command:

```bash
bash scripts/run_cifar10_geometry.sh runs
```

Expected files:

```text
runs/cifar10_geometry/seed_0/checkpoints/autoencoder_final.pt
runs/cifar10_geometry/seed_0/checkpoints/chord_final.pt
runs/cifar10_geometry/seed_0/checkpoints/rfm_final.pt
```

The autoencoder checkpoint is required by the conditional and information-control runs.

### CIFAR-10 conditional run

Command:

```bash
bash scripts/run_cifar10_conditional.sh \
  runs \
  runs/cifar10_geometry/seed_0/checkpoints/autoencoder_final.pt
```

Expected prior checkpoint:

```text
runs/cifar10_conditional/seed_0/checkpoints/cond_rfm_final.pt
```

### CIFAR-10 baseline/VAE preparation

Set the completed SRUL checkpoints, then run:

```bash
export SRUL_AE_CHECKPOINT=runs/cifar10_geometry/seed_0/checkpoints/autoencoder_final.pt
export SRUL_PRIOR_CHECKPOINT=runs/cifar10_conditional/seed_0/checkpoints/cond_rfm_final.pt
bash scripts/run_cifar10_matched_baselines.sh runs/final_comparison
```

This run produces the VAE files used by the VAE support-matching experiment:

```text
runs/final_comparison/CIFAR10/seed_0/checkpoints/ldm_autoencoder_final.pt
runs/final_comparison/CIFAR10/seed_0/checkpoints/ldm_latent_stats.pt
runs/final_comparison/CIFAR10/seed_0/generation_metrics.csv
```

Use them as follows:

```bash
export VAE_CHECKPOINT=runs/final_comparison/CIFAR10/seed_0/checkpoints/ldm_autoencoder_final.pt
export VAE_LATENT_STATS=runs/final_comparison/CIFAR10/seed_0/checkpoints/ldm_latent_stats.pt
export PREVIOUS_METRICS_CSV=runs/final_comparison/CIFAR10/seed_0/generation_metrics.csv
bash scripts/run_cifar10_vae_geometry.sh runs
```

### PathMNIST

Command:

```bash
bash scripts/run_pathmnist.sh runs
```

Expected autoencoder checkpoint:

```text
runs/pathmnist/seed_0/checkpoints/autoencoder_final.pt
```

Use this file for `run_pathmnist_knob_cfg.sh`.

### CelebA-64

Command:

```bash
bash scripts/run_celeba64.sh runs data/celeba64
```

Expected autoencoder checkpoint:

```text
runs/celeba64/seed_0/checkpoints/autoencoder_final.pt
```

Use this file for `run_celeba64_knob_cfg.sh`.

## Colab/Google Drive examples

The reported runs used paths similar to:

```text
/content/drive/MyDrive/SRUL_CIFAR10/spatial_v1/seed_0/checkpoints/autoencoder_final.pt
/content/drive/MyDrive/SRUL_CIFAR10/conditional_v1/seed_0/checkpoints/cond_rfm_final.pt
/content/drive/MyDrive/SRUL_PathMNIST/conditional_v1/seed_0/checkpoints/autoencoder_final.pt
/content/drive/MyDrive/SRUL_CelebA64/conditional_v1/seed_0/checkpoints/autoencoder_final.pt
```

These are private storage paths, not files distributed with the GitHub repository.

## Why weights are not committed

Model checkpoints are excluded by `.gitignore`:

```text
*.pt
*.pth
*.ckpt
```

For public distribution, large weights should be placed in a GitHub Release, Hugging Face repository, or shared cloud folder rather than committed to normal Git history.
